people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: Then Zedekiah the king sent and took Jeremiah the prophet to himself into the third entry that is in Yahweh’s house. Then the king said to Jeremiah, “I will ask you something. Hide nothing from me.”
translations.bsb: Then King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah the prophet and received him at the third entrance to the house of the LORD. “I am going to ask you something,” said the king to Jeremiah. “Do not hide anything from me.”
